Hello and welcome to Plain 1.0. As mentioned earlier this is a fairly simple
template, powered entirely by css and xhtml. I am also trying to make as
much use of whitespace as possible. Whitespace helps keep the page
looking clean and easy on the eye, whilst improving readability also. As
with all my templates, a limited number of images have been used, and
when they have, they've been to aid the design. This results in an easily customisable
template that can be used to an array of different sites.

As anyone looking for a website template to use would expect - this
								template is of course,

valid according to the w3c.
								The benfits of this include;
The website rendering correctly in a wide range of browser platforms
Since CSS is used to maximise the aesthetics of the website the load times are
extremely low making for an extremely accessable website.
Low use of images saves bandwidth and improves load times
